description: This PHP source file defines a class called ResourceObserver, which implements the base class for an observer pattern used in resource management within a CRM framework. It includes a constructor, setters, and a notification method.

classes.name: ResourceObserver
classes.description: A base class implementing the observer pattern for resource notifications, holding module information, limit, and providing notification logic.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes the ResourceObserver with a specific module.

methods.name: setLimit
methods.description: Sets a limit value for the observer.

methods.name: notify
methods.description: Outputs or terminates based on an error message, simulating a notification for resource events.
